header: What logistics managers say about our drivers

testimonials.quote: The 21:00 departure has left Oslo on time 51 weeks out of 52. Our store managers have stopped phoning us to ask where the chilled pallets are.
Four fixed windows a day let us take 5,000 units of buffer stock off the yard. The drivers know our gate procedure better than some of our own staff.
When a trailer failed south of Bologna, the depot had a replacement loaded within three hours and told us about it before we noticed.
